clauses.title: Input syllables
clauses.text: Import already segmented mono syllable files.

clauses.title: Human types
clauses.text: Listen and select an existing human type, or create a new type.

clauses.title: Status and records
clauses.text: Drafts, submitted records and completion states are displayed separately.

clauses.title: Item identity
clauses.text: Use stable syllable IDs, pages and review rounds to locate existing records.

clauses.title: Syllable boundaries
clauses.text: Open original-audio context when a boundary needs investigation.

clauses.title: Display range
clauses.text: Display settings controls waveform and spectrogram parameters.

clauses.title: Candidate groups
clauses.text: Expand Candidate Groups and prepare audition pages for the selected group.

clauses.title: Global pool
clauses.text: Find syllables awaiting disposition in Global pool.

clauses.title: Acoustic representation
clauses.text: Inspect the acoustic settings for this run in the candidate workspace.

clauses.title: Review entry
clauses.text: Open an existing round to continue auditioning its original pages.

clauses.title: Syllable comparison
clauses.text: Use Ctrl to select several syllables, then Play or Loop to compare them.

clauses.title: Prepare group
clauses.text: Prepare group creates audition pages for the selected scope.

clauses.title: Sources and references
clauses.text: Use Item tools to inspect sources and references for the current syllable.

clauses.title: Review members
clauses.text: Pages show the members frozen when this round was prepared.

clauses.title: Scope changes
clauses.text: Follow the page prompts to prepare a new round when membership changes.

clauses.title: Fine review
clauses.text: Fine review records detailed judgments for an individual syllable.

clauses.title: Type definitions
clauses.text: Maintain type cards and diagnostic descriptions in the type-definition workspace.

clauses.title: Unresolved membership
clauses.text: Choose Family unresolved when membership cannot yet be determined.

clauses.title: Additional observations
clauses.text: Select one syllable to add observations in Notes.

clauses.title: Examples
clauses.text: Catalogue examples link to the corresponding syllable images and audio.

clauses.title: Dispositions
clauses.text: Use the available dispositions for current family, other family, new family, unresolved and excluded.

clauses.title: Save an item or page
clauses.text: Save and next submits the current item; Save page submits eligible items on this page.

clauses.title: Drafts and history
clauses.text: The project stores submitted records and restores matching unsubmitted page drafts.

clauses.title: Finish a review
clauses.text: Record closing notes after completing the required checks for the round.

clauses.title: Delivery scope
clauses.text: Select the scope for this confirmation in Final checks.

clauses.title: Task status
clauses.text: View background tasks and results in View → Tasks.

clauses.title: Prepare again
clauses.text: Enter the requested reason when preparing a new audition round.

clauses.title: Directed review
clauses.text: Locate items needing further audition from the type-definition workspace.

clauses.title: Historical checkpoints
clauses.text: Open Checkpoints and history from Project.

clauses.title: Catalogue export
clauses.text: Select draft or complete mode in Catalogue delivery to export the catalogue.

clauses.title: Internal assessment
clauses.text: Inspect results supported by saved records in Internal assessment.

clauses.title: Recording sources
clauses.text: Register original-recording identifiers in Project → Recording sources.
